title: Treatise on Heavy Cleaving Against Armor
summary: Teaches how to concentrate qi in the bit to cleave through plate and mail with full-body strokes.

title: Handbook of Set Stance and Heavy Chop
summary: A handbook of rooted stances from which the greataxe delivers a few devastating chops while giving no ground.

title: Open Ground Course for the Great Axe
summary: A course for holding open ground against several foes by sweeping and stepping with a great axe.

title: Treatise of the Iron-Cleaving Breath
summary: Joins the extended qi field to the stroke so the cleave carries force past the edge itself.

title: Canon of Qi Behind the Falling Edge
summary: A canon that pushes qi through the haft behind the falling edge to multiply the force of each blow.

title: Twin-Track Treatise of the Great Bit
summary: Teaches the great bit on both tracks at once with qi in the haft while the footwork follows the second track.

title: The Paired Stroke Handbook
summary: A handbook of strokes that come in pairs with the second cut always answering the first.

title: Hawk-Stoop Canon for the Greataxe
summary: A canon built on the hawk's stoop with a high rise and a single falling stroke from above.

title: Treatise of the Azure River Cleave
summary: A treatise on cleaves that flow like a river with each stroke feeding the next along the field of qi.

title: Wind-Sworn Handbook of the Heavy Cut
summary: A handbook for wind-sworn axe-bearers who let the wind lend speed to a heavy stroke.

title: Plateau Edge Canon of the Great Axe
summary: A canon from the plateau edge teaching strokes that hold a line with nothing behind the wielder.

title: Oath-Bearing Treatise on the Hewing Stroke
summary: A treatise on the hewing stroke sworn to one bearing and held against any force that turns it.

title: Bearing and Gale: A Greataxe Course
summary: A course that fixes a bearing on the foe and lets the gale carry the axe through the line.
